_readme: Reference tax data for scripts/salary_compare.py. Federal/FICA figures are recalled from IRS Rev. Proc. 2025-32 and SSA announcements; state figures are best-known 2026 rates. The salary-compare skill re-verifies every state it uses against the state revenue department and updates the entry (rate, source, verified_on) before any number is trusted. A state missing here can be handled with location.state_tax_rate_pct in the config.
_verification_note: verified=true covers federal/single, FICA, and MI (the only filing status/state actually in use so far) -- confirmed live 2026-09-27 against Michigan Treasury and IRS 2026 inflation-adjustment figures (see per-entry source/verified_on). federal/mfj and every other state remain unverified. Per SKILL.md Step 3, re-verify (and update the relevant entry) whenever a real offer introduces a new state or filing status.

single.source: IRS 2026 inflation adjustments (Tax Foundation summary, confirmed $16,100 single standard deduction and $12,400/$50,400/$105,700 bracket thresholds)

WA.note: No wage tax; 7% capital-gains excise not modelled

MI.note: Personal exemption (~$5,400/filer for 2026, indexed annually) ignored, overstates tax by ~$230. Confirmed 4.25%: FY2025 general-fund growth did not exceed inflation, so no rate-adjustment trigger for 2026. City taxes go in location.local_tax_pct (e.g. Detroit 2.4%; Northville and Ann Arbor have none).

OH.note: 2026 flat rate; first ~$26k exempt (ignored). School-district and municipal taxes go in location.local_tax_pct.

IN.note: County income tax (0.5-3%) goes in location.local_tax_pct.

PA.note: Local earned-income tax goes in location.local_tax_pct.

CA.note: Bracket thresholds are 2025 values; also ~1.2% SDI on wages not modelled. Verify.
